bio: Cairn Lodge is a boutique hotel, nestled in the heart of rural Perthshire, built in 1903 as a hunting lodge.  The Garden Room, flooded with sunlight, overlooking the well-manicured gardens and the outdoor terrace, is the perfect spot to enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea.  Choose from a selection of Strathearn Herbal Tea or Nemaya Carraro Coffee along with Chef’s artisan sandwiches, freshly baked plain and fruit scones with jam and clotted cream, a selection of homemade cakes and Chef’s hot Afternoon Tea delicacies.  Afternoon Tea is available from Monday to Saturday from 12pm to 4pm (must be booked in advance) and costs £32 per person, or £45 with a glass of Champagne.
